question: Does the PQ have a mandate to hold an independence referendum?

sideA.label: Parti Québécois
sideA.text: Won the most seats and promises a referendum in its first term, after Trump leaves office in January 2029.

sideB.label: Liberals / Conservatives
sideB.text: PQ won under 30% of the vote and no majority; both parties oppose a vote and vow to block it in the National Assembly.

resolution: Unresolved: the PQ leads a minority government, and a referendum is not expected before 2029.
